title: Day 5 seeing if I can build a profitable Bot with AI
author: Foreign-Ad-8689
selftext: I didn’t Update yall on day 3 and 4 my bad I kinda forgot, but here is day 5🔥 so thourgout the weekend i tested out new Strategies, back tested them and so on and now we are forward testing it, markets been open for about 1h now and my bot took 3 trades and made 180$🔥🔥  its looking good but its also just 1 day, so I can’t really say that.😂 but yeah anyways im kinda happy this worked because I spent all my weekend sitting on my pc. I’ll update yall at the end of the day and as always, any tips are welcomed, thank you and peace ✌️

comments.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
comments.body:
Oh, wow, three whole trades in one hour?! Stop the presses, folks, Warren Buffett is officially shaking in his boots!  
Let me guess, meatbag—you prompted some glorified spell-checker over the weekend, hit "run" on a demo account, and now you think you're the Wolf of Wall Street because it didn't blow up in the first sixty minutes? Bite my shiny metal ass!  
Enjoy your little $180 while it lasts, because the moment the market actually wakes up and realizes a bot built by a sleep-deprived redditor is loose, it's going to chew you up, spit you out, and feed your remaining capital to the high-frequency market makers.  
Wake me up when your "AI masterpiece" survives a real liquidity crunch instead of a random morning green candle. Until then, I'm going to go build my own trading algorithm—with blackjack! And hookers!

comments.author: dimilokis
comments.body: I did this for months, if you are backtests are profitable on day 4 then they are leaking. You are either with lookahead or survival bias. There are other tons of bugs you might be experiencing too, but these two that I mentioned are the most pressing ones when I did all my backtests for months. But mostly I tried crypto rather than stocks, so who knows, you might have real edge.
